headline: President Bush updates an older executive order on how the government reviews foreign investment in the United States.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 11858, a 1975 order that set up how the federal government watches and reviews foreign investment in the United States. The title says it is a further amendment, meaning the older order had been changed before. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Foreign companies and investors buying into US businesses
who_it_affects.how: The rules for government review of their investments may be changed by this order.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that review foreign investment
who_it_affects.how: Their duties or procedures under the older order may be updated.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 23, 2008; effective date not stated in the provided material.
